{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
df_clean = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_float'] != 999999.99)]

# Check the final population
print("Final population size:", len(df_clean))
print("QA orders removed:", len(df) - len(df_clean))

# Check conversion rate by channel, now clean
print("Conversion rate by channel (clean):\n", df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean())

# Check customer segment distribution by channel in clean data
print("Customer segment by channel (clean):\n", df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
